## How this is measured

- **Placeholder function**: a named function whose whole body is `pass`, `...`, `raise NotImplementedError`, `throw new Error("not implemented")`, `todo!()`, `panic("not implemented")`, a docstring only, or empty. Abstract and overloaded methods, constructors and dunder methods are skipped.
- **Unreferenced file**: Python only. Imports in other languages are not yet resolved to files reliably, so a used TypeScript file could look unused; those are not reported.
- **Forwarder**: a function whose body is one call that passes its own parameters, in order, to another function.
- **Single-subclass base**: a class named like a base (Base, Abstract, Interface, `I` prefix) that exactly one other class extends.
- No AI model is used. Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Rust, Java.
